answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 5766 Country: United States of America Title: When there is a Namaaz being led by Imam in Jamaat of about 7 safay, is it allowed for 1 or 2 persons to stand next to Imam and pray along with him? Can a Imam leading prayers hold a cordless microphone in his hand while performing Namaaz? Can a Namazi pick up his child in between his Namaaz and continue to pray with the child on his shoulders? Question: When there is a Namaaz being led by Imam in Jamaat of about 7 safay, is it allowed for 1 or 2 persons to stand next to Imam and pray along with him? Can a Imam leading prayers hold a cordless microphone in his hand while performing Namaaz? Can a Namazi pick up his child in between his Namaaz and continue to pray with the child on his shoulders? Answer ID: 5766 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 614/571=L/1429) No, it is in no way allowed, even if someone proceeds imam his salah will turn invalid. (2) If he holds microphone to his mouth while praying salah then his salah will become invalid. (3) The salah will be nullified by picking up the child to take him on his shoulders (if both the hands were used or occurred any thing contrary to salah ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
